paper_title: Continual Dialogue State Tracking via Reason-of-Select Distillation
caption: : Error rate for slots
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of error rates for different slots. The chart is divided into twenty segments, and includes a legend displaying each slot label and corresponding percentage. The segments are colored in a variety of hues including blue, orange, red, green, purple, and yellow. The largest segment, representing “from,” occupies approximately 17.00% of the chart, followed by “date” at 19.30% and "to" at 14.50%. Other segments, in descending order of size, include “genre” (13.50%), “name” (5.20%), “size” (4.20%), “intent” (3.80%), “location” (3.80%), “destination” (3.00%), “city” (2.60%), “class” (2.40%), "beds" (1.30%) and "time" (4.10%). The remaining segments are smaller, with "range" contributing 2.20%, and "passengers" at 1.10%. No slices are visually emphasized.
